Description: 
 PETA’s Video Lab is a team of creative problem-solvers and storytellers behind some of the organization’s most talked-about animal rights videos on social media. From provocative, hilarious content that taps into the cultural conversation to emotionally powerful stories that motivate people to act, the Video Lab creates work that consistently cuts through the noise. Videos produced by PETA’s Video Lab generate roughly 100 million views each year, offering an extraordinary opportunity to experiment with emerging creative technology and make work that has a meaningful impact on animals.


  Position Description:


 PETA’s social channels reach millions of people every week—and this role sits at the center of that impact. As an AI Creative Producer — Social Video, you’ll create visually striking, culturally relevant, and emotionally powerful videos for PETA’s social platforms, with a strong emphasis on AI-assisted animation, original visual storytelling, and self-filmed content.


 Your work will help make PETA’s animal liberation message compelling, shareable, and impossible to ignore—whether through humor and provocative commentary or powerful stories that build empathy for animals and inspire people to take action.


 We’re looking for a highly creative, chronically online producer with strong creative instincts and a genuine connection to PETA’s mission. You should be excited to experiment with emerging AI tools and develop work that can be bold, funny, unexpected, heartbreaking, or moving, all via a new creative medium. Above all, you should understand that technology is a tool for telling great stories and helping people see animals as individuals.

 Leverage AI tools to create bold content, appear on camera, create skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and more

  Create high-impact videos for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube, and emerging social channels, from concept through final delivery

  Experiment with emerging AI-powered video, animation, and creative technologies to develop innovative content and formats
  Combine AI-generated elements with traditional editing, animation, self-shot footage, and other production techniques to create the strongest possible story
  Create characters for comedic skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and other original formats that bring PETA’s bold and distinctive voice to life
  Develop emotionally compelling stories that build empathy for animals, help audiences see them as individuals, and motivate people to take action
  Self-film content when needed, using an iPhone or similar equipment, taking ownership of lighting, sound, props, set design, and overall production quality
  Direct and produce formal shoots as needed
  Collaborate closely with Video Lab team members and the social media team to develop timely, engaging content
  Ensure all video content meets quality standards and complies with legal and brand guidelines
  Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, internet culture, and advancements in AI creative tools

  Degree in a related field, relevant professional experience, or a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative ability
  Portfolio showcasing generative AI work, creative video projects, or personal AI-driven experiments. We care about what you’ve made, whether it comes from professional work, social content, animations, spec pieces, short films, or personal projects
  Demonstrated experience using AI tools for video generation, animation, visual effects, or video enhancement
  Strong understanding of visual storytelling and all stages of video production, from concept development through post-production
  Excellent video-editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable tools
  Familiarity with video, lighting, and photography equipment

  Curiosity about emerging creative technology and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools and techniques

jobs.title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.description: Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed. The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision. RESPONSIBILITIES Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. REQUIREMENTS 4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories. Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails). Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools change under you. STRONG PLUSES Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work. Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it. Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters. Video editing or motion/VFX background

At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work.

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed. The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision. RESPONSIBILITIES Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. REQUIREMENTS 4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories. Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails). Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools change under you. STRONG PLUSES Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work. Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it. Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters. Video editing or motion/VFX background
